en.title: Î
en.summary: The letter Î is the tenth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: The letter î
paragraphs: The letter name is spoken as the sound /ɨ/. It makes this sound in the word (înger) /ɨn.t͡seˈleɡ/, which means to understand. This letter has only one sound in Romanian.

sections.title: Pronouncing the sound
paragraphs: Pull your tongue straight back into the middle of your mouth. Keep your lips relaxed and spread flat. Let your voice hum steadily from your throat. Touch your neck with two fingers to feel the strong vibration.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always keeps the same value. It makes the sound /ɨ/ in every position, as shown in the word (hotărî) /ho.təˈrɨ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace this vowel with the vowel in the English word sit. Do not make the sound in boot with circle lips either. Pull your tongue back, keep your lips flat, and make the sound deep inside your mouth.
